The weakest point of this course comes from the existence of other courses that are scheduled in the same semester with this course in the current IE curriculum. This is arguably the most important course in the whole IE curriculum as it is where we are expexted to utilize all of our IE knowledge since the beginning of our university lives. As a student who never went out of the curriculum schedule and took every course in its originally designated semester, I believe that the other courses we take in the same semester extremely decrease our efficiency in this course. I think that the importance and essentiality of this course requires a change in the whole IE curriculum. The faculty should get rid of the most of the courses in the freshman year, such as MATH 101-102, PHYS 101-102, TURK 101-102, and some of the sophomore year courses such as HUM 111-112, HIST 200 as well as the junior year course GE 301 and they can pull the sophomore year to the freshmen year, pull the junior year to the sophomore year and pull the senior year (except this course) to the junior year. That way we can finally, fully focus on this course and give it our full potential. With the current curriculum this course just feels like any other course, howeveri this should not be the case as the main idea behind this course is to make us familiar to the real industrial world outside the school and finally being able to take experience a real engineer's responsibilities. I believe that the faculty should think about this matter and I think that our course coordinators are also aware of this problem as they must have observed a serious lack of focus from the students regarding this course's material.
